content.text:
I found one visible problem on the home page and fixed it. I'm not sure it's the problem you meant.

The hero section had a 1px bottom border that ran straight through the stats cards ("12,400 orders shipped…"). The cards overlap the bottom of the hero by design, so the line cut across behind all three of them. I removed that `border-bottom` from `.hero` in `site/css/pages.css`. The hero's gradient already fades into the page background, so it still looks finished without the line.

I checked this by screenshotting the page at 1280px wide before and after the change. The 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't diff against "the last change" to see what it touched. Everything else on the page looks normal, but I only checked the desktop width. If something else looks off to you, tell me what you see (or which screen size) and I'll look at that.

STATUS: DONE
